title: A job interview
instructions: Elena bir kafede garsonluk için görüşmeye giriyor. Uzun bir diyalog; deneyim, çalışma saatleri ve ücrete dikkat et.

script.speaker: boss
script.text: Hello, Elena. Thanks for coming. Please sit down.

script.speaker: boss
script.text: So, have you worked in a café before?

script.speaker: elena
script.text: Yes, I worked in a coffee shop for two years when I was at university.

script.speaker: boss
script.text: Good. Why do you want to work here?

script.speaker: elena
script.text: I love meeting people, and your café is very close to my house. I can walk here.

script.speaker: boss
script.text: Can you work at the weekend?

script.speaker: elena
script.text: Saturdays are fine, but I can't work on Sundays. I visit my grandmother every Sunday.

script.speaker: boss
script.text: That's OK. We need someone from Monday to Saturday, from eight to two.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: That sounds perfect. How much is the pay?

script.speaker: boss
script.text: Eleven pounds an hour, and you can have free lunch.

questions.prompt: How long did Elena work in a coffee shop?
questions.evidence: I worked in a coffee shop for two years

questions.prompt: Why can't Elena work on Sundays?
questions.evidence: I visit my grandmother every Sunday.

questions.feedback: Pazartesiden cumartesiye sekizden ikiye (from eight to two).

questions.prompt: What does Elena get besides money?
questions.feedback: Saatlik on bir poundun yanında öğle yemeği bedava (free lunch).
